page_note: 这是一页EIA幻灯片，包含一张横向堆积条形图，比较十家能源公司2024年已探明与未探明储量收购的上游支出（十亿2024美元）。

heading.title: Upstream costs incurred for select energy companies

components.evidence: each company row is one bar of a light-blue then a darker-blue segment, total is bar length
company names sit on the y axis; bars grow rightward to the $0-$100 axis below
vertical rules at $0, $20, $40, $60, $80, $100; no horizontal rules in the plot
"billion 2024 dollars" printed under the bold heading; axis shows only $0...$100
"Data source: Evaluate Energy" in small print below the plot
"proved reserve acquisition" / "unproved reserve acquisition" set as a right-hand column level with the bars

new_components.name: color_text_legend_no_swatch
new_components.evidence: legend entries are just the series names typed in the light and dark blue fill colours, no key swatches
new_components.why_it_matters: 读者必须靠文字颜色与条段颜色匹配来确定哪个段是proved、哪个是unproved，缺少色块会让系列归属易错。

new_components.name: currency_prefixed_axis_ticks
new_components.evidence: value axis reads "$0, $20, $40, $60, $80, $100" with a dollar sign on every tick
new_components.why_it_matters: 刻度自带$符号但单位（十亿2024美元）在标题行，读数时要把两处信息合起来才知道量级。

new_components.name: slide_sentence_headline
new_components.evidence: blue two-line takeaway sentence "Ten companies accounted for nearly 90% ..." above the chart's bold heading
new_components.why_it_matters: 图的真正标题是加粗那行，蓝色长句是结论句；解析时若误取结论句作标题，行标签的上下文就错位。

spot_checks.mark: the Exxon Mobil Corporation light-blue (proved reserve acquisition) segment, ending just under the $40 gridline
the Exxon Mobil Corporation dark-blue unproved segment, from ~$39 to the bar end near $85
the Diamondback Energy Inc. light-blue proved segment, ending just past $20
the Diamondback Energy Inc. dark-blue unproved segment (bar total ~37); the ConocoPhillips proved segment measures similarly
the Expand Energy Corporation light-blue proved segment, ending between $0 and $20
the Occidental Petroleum Corporation light-blue proved segment
the ConocoPhillips dark-blue unproved segment, from ~$16 to the bar end near $25
the Canadian Natural Resources Limited bar, essentially all light-blue proved, ending short of $10
the California Resources Corporation light-blue proved segment, the shortest bar on the chart

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，刻度间隔$20约140像素（每美元约7像素），小段的5%容差极小：3的容差是±0.15（约1像素），7是±0.35（2.5像素），9、10也只有3-4像素余量；而且unproved段必须用堆积末端减去proved末端两次读数相减，误差叠加。相比之下行标签只需“公司名+系列名”两个键，表格容易承载，所以卡点在像素读数精度。

suggestions.what_to_add: P1式的按段可达精度：把细堆积段（如3、7）标记为低精度目标而非布尔可读
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段中为每个mark加attainable_tolerance，条件行按段长/像素长度分档
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 新增“堆积段像素长度<30px”一行，对比整段与细段的读数命中率

suggestions.what_to_add: currency_prefixed_axis_ticks（刻度格式带$前缀）与单位位置分离
suggestions.where_to_change: style字段的tick_format与unit_position两项，条件行加“刻度带货币符号且单位在副标题”
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 新增“刻度$前缀 + 单位仅在标题行”一行，检验单位是否被正确附加到数值

suggestions.what_to_add: P7的标题拆分：区分蓝色结论句、加粗小标题与单位行
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 新增“存在结论式大标题 + 独立加粗图题”一行，测试标题字段抽取的正确率

suggestions.what_to_add: color_text_legend_no_swatch（无色块、仅彩色文字的侧置图例）
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 新增“图例无色块”一行，考察系列名与条段颜色的绑定是否仍成立
